workflows.sub: Chains of steps that prepare ideas, posts and planner items from your content.
workflows.localOnly: Runs only while this browser is open on this device. Nothing is scheduled in the cloud; nothing is posted and no one is replied to.
workflows.storageBlocked: This browser isn't saving right now (storage blocked or full), so workflows can't be saved or run.
workflows.emptyHint: Try: article ready → idea + post + planner item.
workflows.triggerHelp.manual: You start it with Run now.
workflows.triggerHelp.article-ready: Runs when you move an article from draft to Ready in Website.
workflows.pausedNote: Run now is off while paused, and Ready articles don't start it.
workflows.placeholdersHelp: You can use in the text:
workflows.previewNote: Preview only: nothing was saved or sent.
workflows.previewSampleNone: On a sample article (no article is ready yet)
workflows.previewSkipped: Would be skipped: an earlier step failed
workflows.save.notPersisted: Not saved: the browser didn't keep the change. Your edits are still here.
workflows.save.unsupported: This browser can't save safely (no Web Locks), so nothing was saved.
workflows.save.conflict: Changed in another tab or by an import. Your edits are still here; nothing was overwritten.
workflows.issue.plan-skill: The planner item's skill doesn't exist
workflows.issue.skill-needs-article: Pick a skill for the planner item (a manual run has no article)
workflows.issue.placeholder-needs-articl: Title, summary and slug need an article: run it “When an article is ready”
workflows.runError.not-retryable: This run doesn't need a retry.
workflows.gone: This workflow doesn't exist on this device.
workflows.needsArticle: This workflow needs an article: write one in Website first, then run it on that article.
workflows.resumeNote: The run stopped because the browser didn't save a step. Resume continues where it stopped, without repeating.
workflows.unsavedPrompt: You have unsaved edits from last time. Restore them?
workflows.runError.not-local: This workflow is linked to the cloud Worker (or that link isn't clear yet), so it won't run on this device. Nothing ran.
workflows.cloud.title: Cloud
workflows.cloud.note: Everything here is a button you press: nothing is sent by itself or checked in the background. Cloud runs have their own list, separate from this device's runs.
workflows.cloud.chip.unsupported: Its id can't go on the cloud
workflows.cloud.anotherHelp: This workflow is linked to a different Worker than the one in Settings, so nothing here changes it.
workflows.cloud.unsupportedHelp: The cloud only takes ids made of letters, digits, - and _ (up to 64).
workflows.cloud.capacityHelp: The cloud holds at most {max} workflows. Take one off first.
workflows.cloud.connect.none: No Worker set yet. Add its address and token in Settings.
workflows.cloud.connect.bad: The Worker address or token in Settings can't be used: {reason}
workflows.cloud.connect.need: Check the connection first to use the cloud buttons.
workflows.cloud.handshake.uncertain: No clear answer from the Worker. Try Check connection again.
workflows.cloud.intent.refused: The Worker refused, so nothing changed.
workflows.cloud.intent.uncertain: Sent, but no clear answer — press Recover to check.
workflows.cloud.intent.dispatching: Sent and waiting for an answer — press Recover to check.
workflows.cloud.intent.pending: Saved here, not sent yet — press Recover.
workflows.cloud.intent.divergent: The Worker's answer doesn't match what we saved — press Recover.
workflows.cloud.sent: Sent, but no clear answer. Check status before doing anything else.
workflows.cloud.notSent: Nothing was sent (the screen or settings changed). Try again.
workflows.cloud.notSaved: The Worker answered, but this browser couldn't save it ({reason}). Check status again.
workflows.cloud.invalidAnswer: The Worker's answer wasn't valid, so nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.reason.disposed: The page was closed. Open it again.
workflows.cloud.reason.not_configured: No Worker is set up in Settings.
workflows.cloud.reason.insecure: The Worker address must use https.
workflows.cloud.reason.no_browser: This only works in the browser.
workflows.cloud.reason.invalid_request: The request wasn't valid, so it wasn't sent.
workflows.cloud.reason.unsupported_kind: This kind of request can't be sent.
workflows.cloud.reason.too_large: Bigger than the cloud limits. Nothing was cut.
workflows.cloud.reason.foreign_origin: This belongs to a Worker at another address.
workflows.cloud.reason.foreign_owner: This belongs to another Worker account.
workflows.cloud.reason.owner_mismatch: The Worker account changed. Check the connection.
workflows.cloud.reason.superseded: A newer press replaced it, so it wasn't sent.
workflows.cloud.reason.unreadable: We couldn't read the cloud records saved here.
workflows.cloud.reason.journal_unreadabl: We couldn't read the cloud run list saved here.
workflows.cloud.reason.unresolved: An earlier request is unclear. Press Recover first.
workflows.cloud.reason.capacity: The limit is reached. Remove an older one first.
workflows.cloud.reason.busy: Another request is running. Wait a moment.
workflows.cloud.reason.stale_record: The record changed in another tab. Try again.
workflows.cloud.reason.not_persisted: This browser didn't save, so nothing was sent.
workflows.cloud.reason.moved: It moved or changed in another tab.
workflows.cloud.reason.suppressed: Held after a reset: Send and Run are off; Check status and Cancel still work.
workflows.cloud.reason.collision: A draft here already uses that id, so nothing was taken over it.
workflows.cloud.reason.inconsistent: Some drafts it made are no longer here.
workflows.cloud.reason.stale: Something changed meanwhile, so nothing was written.
workflows.cloud.reason.conflict: It conflicts with what the Worker has.
workflows.cloud.reason.not_registered: This workflow isn't registered with the Worker.
workflows.cloud.reason.pruned: The Worker removed it after it finished.
workflows.cloud.reason.absent: The Worker doesn't have this run.
workflows.cloud.reason.running: It's still running on the Worker.
workflows.cloud.reason.unsupported_id: The id can't go on the cloud.
workflows.cloud.reason.digest_mismatch: The content doesn't match the Worker's.
workflows.cloud.reason.authority_mismatc: This belongs to another Worker account.
workflows.cloud.reason.retirement_full: The list of finished, retired results is full.
workflows.cloud.reason.mismatch: The content doesn't match what we saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.missing: This workflow wasn't found. Nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.paused: Paused: turn it on first. Nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.issues: Fix the notes first. Nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.needs-article: Pick an existing article (not archived). Nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.archived: The article is archived. Nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.blocked: We can't prove who runs it (this device or the cloud), so nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.authority-mismat: It's registered with a different Worker than the connected one. Nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.registration-pau: It's paused on the cloud. Nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.definition-misma: You edited it after putting it on the cloud. Take it off and put it on again. Nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.chronology: The run time is before it went on the cloud. Nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.manual-on-ready: This one runs "When an article is ready": mark the article ready in Website. Nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.snapshot: We couldn't prepare the run's copy. Nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.too-large: Bigger than the cloud limits. Nothing was cut or saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.limitation: A step can't run on the cloud. Nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.invalid: The data isn't valid. Nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.capacity: The cloud run list here is full. Nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.conflict: A saved run has the same id with other content. Nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.suppressed: Held after a reset. Nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.stale: Something changed meanwhile (we don't retry). Try again.
workflows.cloud.capture.journal-unreadab: We couldn't read the cloud run list here. Nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.unsupported-save: This browser can't save here. Nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.capture.not-persisted: This browser didn't save. Nothing was saved.
workflows.cloud.captured: A cloud run was saved. Press Send on it below.
workflows.cloud.entry.rejected: A saved answer didn't check out and is ignored.
workflows.cloud.results.title: Cloud results
workflows.cloud.results.more: There's more — press Fetch results again.
workflows.cloud.deliver.title: Confirm delivery
workflows.cloud.deliver.help: These finished on the cloud and their drafts are here. Confirm so the Worker can tidy up.
workflows.cloud.deliver.done: The Worker noted it. Press Check status later so it's retired here.
workflows.cloud.proofFull: Paused: this browser holds {max} finished results, the limit. Confirm delivery for finished ones, then press Check status on them below so they're retired, then fetch results again.
workflows.cloud.retirementFull: Paused: {max} retired results are kept here, the limit. Nothing was lost. Press Check status on the results below; new ones wait until there's room.
workflows.cloud.chip.noWorker: Linked to a Worker — set it in Settings
workflows.cloud.reason.answer: The Worker answered, but cloud workflows aren't available there yet.
workflows.cloud.worker.not_configured: Cloud workflows aren't set up on the Worker itself yet.
workflows.cloud.reason.unknown_epoch: The Worker doesn't know this registration round.
workflows.cloud.reason.registration_behi: Its registration on the Worker is older than needed.
workflows.cloud.reason.future_version: The answer is newer than this page knows. Reload the page.
workflows.cloud.reason.bad_request: The Worker said the request wasn't valid.
workflows.cloud.reason.method_not_allowe: The Worker doesn't accept this kind of request.
workflows.cloud.reason.receipt_unavailab: The Worker couldn't return the run's status right now.
workflows.cloud.reason.compact_feed: The answer was a short summary without enough detail, so it wasn't saved.
workflows.cloud.reason.unverified: We couldn't verify the answer, so it wasn't saved.
workflows.cloud.reason.older: We already have a newer answer.
workflows.cloud.reason.observation_unver: The saved answer couldn't be verified.
workflows.cloud.reason.error: Something went wrong while saving the answer.
workflows.cloud.checked.retired: The Worker tidied it up, and it's retired here now.
